title: What It Really Costs to Own a Lamborghini Urus
description:
A new Lamborghini Urus costs two hundred seventy-six thousand, seven hundred forty-one dollars, according to CARFAX. A used one from twenty nineteen has a median asking price of about one hundred sixty-eight thousand dollars. So the question is not whether you can afford the car. The question is what it costs you after the keys are in your hand. This is what the sources say about the real cost of owning a Lamborghini Urus. Here is the twist. The used price does not fall the way most people assume. The median asking price rises with every model year, and the newest cars are the most expensive. And the one cost that every source agrees on is the one nobody puts in the advert. We will go through all of it, and tell you what we could not find.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
